assets.name: Ozzie’s · Rue de Lust
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one full environment background for Infernal Versus, a 2D fan fighting game set in Helluva Boss. Use the attached image as the precise architectural and palette reference: the exterior of Ozzie's in the Lust Ring. Create a high-quality hand-drawn 2D landscape 16:9 background preserving the recognisable real location: navy-violet starry night sky with broad blue sky streaks, empty glossy wet street receding left of centre, densely packed neon storefronts on the left, imposing magenta Ozzie's facade on the right, huge concentric heart entrance, yellow-orange tall windows, curved plum columns, red and gold drapes, heart-topped details, curved sign reading exactly OZZIE'S. Preserve these buildings and colour relationships; no generic theatre or interior. Adapt the foreground only to a continuous clear horizontal street-level lane across the lower fifth, consistent wet paving and reflections for two side-on game characters to stand on. Keep the existing facade in the upper four fifths, door connected to steps and sidewalk. Remove the small freestanding velvet-rope stanchions from this background because they will be a separate game prop. No people, characters, vehicles, interface, border, signature, invented architecture or extra signs. One scene only. Crisp ink contours, layered flat shading, subtle painted environmental gradients consistent with the supplied series background, no 3D rendering. Output a complete polished background, preferably 2560x1440 or higher. The gameplay lane is an adaptation, while the facade must closely follow the reference.
fidelityNotes: Façade, entrée en cœur, fenêtres, draperies et palette comparées au décor de production public.
Premier plan élargi horizontalement pour le combat ; perspective du trottoir et disposition fine des enseignes adaptées.
Bornes et cordes retirées du fond pour un calque séparé.
Dessin de 1672 × 941 pixels natifs ; aucune certification de fidélité 1:1.
